links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified radiology group patient education documents (ARL 11.72)
links.outcome: Average reading level (ARL) of patient education materials after LLM simplification to a sixth-grade target
links.effect: Original ARL 11.72; ChatGPT-4 ARL 7.32 ± 0.76 (6/7 documents significant); Gemini ARL 6.55 ± 0.51 (7/7 significant). Word count reduced 15% ± 7% (ChatGPT) and 33% ± 7% (Gemini).
links.tradeoff: Neither tool reached the sixth-grade target on average. Some information was lost: 95% of ChatGPT outputs retained at least 75% of information versus 68% for Gemini. Gemini outputs were rated less appropriate (57% vs 95%), clear (67% vs 92%) and relevant (76% vs 95%), with lower interrater agreement (0.46 vs 0.91). The authors say ongoing expert review is needed.
links.quote: ChatGPT ARL was 7.32 ± 0.76 (6/7 significant) and Gemini ARL was 6.55 ± 0.51 (7/7 significant).

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt with radiologist review
